description: A short-circuit result is the projection of its left operand which the bypass edge admits, joined with the right operand: falsy(a) | b for and, truthy(a) | b for or. The operand's other side is refuted by the edge that carries it, so it never enters the result. false stays in the falsy projection of a boolean, the record side of an optional record never reaches an and-chain's result, and the nil side of an optional never reaches an or-chain's. The acyclic and the recurrent form state the same type.
